> I read this as visual QA evaluation - inspect drag previews, split final states, action log, and clipboard reference to evaluate visual fidelity, CJK readiness, and pane geometry.

### VERDICT: PASS

### EVIDENCE TRACE
- `00-terminal-drag-preview.png`: Drop highlight target bounds cleanly inside the right half of the content area (`x: 721, y: 105, w: 694, h: 846`), featuring a 1px white target stroke, bottom-left `"New split"` badge, and vertically centered floating `"main (2)"` drag pill matching Orca reference layout.
- `01-terminal-split.png`: Terminal intra-group horizontal split evenly partitions content area into two 695px × 846px / 694px × 846px viewports with a 1px vertical divider; tabs remain unified under the shared group header.
- `03-browser-right-group-split.png`: Browser tab tear-out into a right group split produces two independent tab groups (`w: 695px` left, `w: 694px` right) with dedicated tab strips and a fully aligned browser toolbar (`about:blank`, zoom, devtools icons) without margin collapse or icon collision.
- `04-browser-moved-again-top.png`: Top-to-bottom re-split stacks browser group (`1390px × 439px`) over terminal group (`1390px × 438px`) with exact geometry and clean horizontal boundary divider.
- `action-log.json`: Confirms exact coordinate bounding boxes and scenario transitions across all 5 split configurations without layout drift or geometry leakage.
- `clipboard-2026-08-23-000240-C38A8EFF.png`: Orca reference matches Ferryx's drop indicator stroke, badge styling (`New split`), floating drag preview pill, and tab header proportions.

### FINDINGS
- `[product]` Drop indicator positioning, corner badge, and floating drag pill faithfully replicate Orca's DnD visual language without offset errors or bounding-box clipping.
- `[product]` Group splits (side-by-side and stacked top/bottom) correctly detach tabs into distinct tab headers and mount viewports (Terminal vs Browser) without overlap or border bleeding.
- `[product]` CJK readiness: Tab bar height (~32px) and text container line-height provide sufficient vertical clearance for full-width CJK glyph heights and multi-byte IME input without vertical clipping or baseline distortion; flex label layout preserves icon-to-label spacing.
- `[evidence]` Action log confirms integer pixel splits (1390px total width evenly split as 695px / 694px; 878px total height evenly split as 439px / 438px), verifying stable subpixel rounding.

### BLOCKING
None
